input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives the Company no mid-term convenience exit (only a 90-day notice tied to the annual renewal) while granting HDI a mirror-image 90-day right that on its face could be exercised mid-term, contrary to our position that the Vendor may not walk away during a committed term. Worse, Section 4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment on any Company termination equal to half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales less $800,000 — roughly 50% of annual Net Sales against fees of only 30% of Net Sales — a penalty far in excess of our 3-month fee cap, and it applies even where we terminate for HDI's failure to perform. The redline adds a 30-day Company convenience right with a refund of prepaid fees, confines HDI's convenience right to end-of-term non-renewal, and caps the Termination Payment at three months' fees with a fault-based carve-out.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day Company convenience exit with refund of prepaid fees, limit HDI's convenience termination to end-of-term non-renewal, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees with a carve-out for termination for HDI's fault.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a 30-day convenience exit for the Company with a refund of prepaid fees and limited HDI's convenience right to non-renewal at the end of the then-current term, since a vendor should not be able to walk away mid-term. We also capped the Termination Payment at three months' fees and carved out terminations for HDI's failure to perform, as our playbook does not accept exit penalties beyond that fallback cap.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: unless terminated in accordance with this Section 4.1. The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to HDI, in which case HDI shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term, upon not less than ninety (90) days prior written notice to the Company. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
